content: Root cause: The bug in the Oozie Streaming actions was caused by an incorrect method signature in the `StreamingMain` class. The method `submitJob` was originally defined with the parameter type `Configuration actionConf`, but it has been changed to `JobConf jobConf`. This led to the incorrect handling of configuration settings, as the method was not using the right configuration object to retrieve necessary properties for streaming actions, resulting in failure during job execution. The patch rectifies this by ensuring the method correctly utilizes the `JobConf` object, enabling proper configuration of the streaming job.
